about: Acme India Industries is a New Delhi-based supplier to the Indian railway rolling-stock sector. It does turnkey interior furnishing of new coaches (LHB, at MCF and ICF production units), refurbishment and upgradation of old coaches, toilet upgradation of coaches, and supplies electrical and other components to Indian Railways. It runs a manufacturing plant and has an order book of about Rs 738 crore as of June 30, 2026.
sector: Railway coach interiors and rolling-stock services

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for additional plant and machinery
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Suraj Pandey (Managing Director) and Sadhvi Pandey (Whole Time Director) took over the business of proprietorship firm M/s Acme India in 2021-22. Suraj Pandey is the selling shareholder in the OFS.

concentration.note: Order book of Rs 737.97 crore (June 30, 2026) is entirely from Indian Railways, a government customer; exact revenue share not given in the provided sections. Top 10 suppliers were 76.95%, 66.88% and 58.15% of purchases in FY26, FY25 and FY24.

litigation_note: Company: 4 criminal cases against it, 1 filed by it, regulatory actions 6 cases (Rs 1.84 crore), direct tax 5 cases (Rs 1.53 crore), indirect tax Rs 2.68 crore. Promoters/directors: 2 other cases (Rs 1.63 crore), tax proceedings 8 cases (direct Rs 4.98 crore, indirect Rs 13.28 crore).
strengths: Established presence in Indian railway interiors with a range of services (furnishing, refurbishment, toilet upgrade) under one roof.
Order book of Rs 737.97 crore as of June 30, 2026 is about 2.8 times FY26 revenue.
Revenue grew 25.6% in FY26 to Rs 263.71 crore; PAT rose 48% to Rs 24.36 crore.
EBITDA margin improved to 15.10% in FY26 from 13.69% in FY25.
Borrowings fell relative to net worth: debt/equity about 0.82 in FY26 versus 1.96 in FY24.
Experienced promoters with domain knowledge and global tie-ups.
Integrated manufacturing plant with equipment from domestic and global suppliers.
IPO proceeds of Rs 41 crore will be used to repay debt, which should cut interest costs.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on Indian Railways
risks.detail: The entire order book of Rs 737.97 crore (June 2026) comes from Indian Railways via tenders; there is no assurance of winning future bids.

risks.title: Very high working capital and stretched receivables
risks.detail: Trade receivable days rose from 263 to 416 (standalone) over FY24-FY26; receivables are Rs 252.18 crore on revenue of Rs 263.71 crore, funded by short-term borrowings of Rs 84.66 crore.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow in two of three years
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs -11.50 crore in FY26 and Rs -6.09 crore in FY24, despite reported profits.

risks.title: Proprietorship assets and unidentified liabilities
risks.detail: Rs 18.25 crore of the proprietor's personal assets were moved into the company and later transferred back, with unidentified liabilities of Rs 35.44 crore also noted; this raises financial-statement accuracy concerns.

risks.title: Revenue mix shifts sharply between segments
risks.detail: Turnkey furnishing was 58.52% of revenue in FY24, 51.59% in FY25 and only 8.29% in FY26; earnings are lumpy and tied to tender timing.

risks.title: Supplier concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers contributed 76.95% of purchases in FY26, up from 58.15% in FY24; supply disruption could delay deliveries.

risks.title: Litigation, compliance lapses and late statutory payments
risks.detail: 4 criminal cases against the company; tax disputes of several crore; many late ROC filings; delays in PF/ESIC and Rs 8.19 crore of income-tax dues overdue as per auditor's report.

risks.title: Leased premises and related-party dependence
risks.detail: Registered and corporate office is leased from promoter Suraj Pandey on an 11-month lease; factory and warehouse are also not owned. Promoters will hold 64.46% post-IPO.

notes: Consolidated restated FY24-FY26, converted from lakhs to Rs crore. Net worth uses KPI table (FY24 Rs 35.63 crore, excludes Rs 0.18 crore share application money); borrowings = long-term + short-term; cash_and_bank = balance sheet cash and bank balance; total assets and PBT as given; P&L table text was garbled and was reconstructed (PBT 3,322.05/2,413.65/2,593.58 lakh agree with cash flow statement). PAT is attributable to owners (FY24 1,920.72-1,920.73 lakh). Debt/equity and current ratios computed (not reported): borrowings/net worth and current assets/current liabilities. Working-capital days are standalone from Objects section. Offer price band, offer size in Rs, P/E blank in RHP. Pre-IPO placement of 10,80,000 shares at Rs 190 (Rs 20.52 crore) on Dec 12, 2025 already reflected in pre-issue shares. Anchor share (up to 60% of QIB) not stated as a percent of offer. Q1FY27 stub not provided. No listed peers.
